hypotheses.justification: A Prop hypothesis (the universal property of R) that no other binder or the conclusion mentions. A search of the file shows `hfac` appears only in its binder, so the proof never uses it. The proof only uses h𝒯.2, the GCResidue lemmas, hraw/hpt built from hcurve, hlev, hker, hx, and P₀.classify_unique. The unchanged proof still compiles without it.
